failure_injections.trigger: Temporarily select a missing/unsupported Motor-CAD executable in an isolated acceptance data directory.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Deep preflight fails closed before native task submission and Studio remains responsive.

failure_injections.trigger: Run the isolated acceptance probe while the required Motor-CAD module license is deliberately unavailable.
failure_injections.expected_signal: License/preflight or native solve reports a classified license failure without producing a trusted ResultBundle.

failure_injections.trigger: Use an isolated Python environment whose PyMotorCAD version differs from the frozen 0.8.8 contract.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Production qualification blocks with PYMOTORCAD_VERSION_MISMATCH before evidence can be promoted.

failure_injections.trigger: Disconnect/terminate the Motor-CAD Automation session during an isolated active native Case.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Case/worker failure is classified, resources are reclaimed, and a subsequent run can create a fresh session.

failure_injections.trigger: Terminate one persistent Motor-CAD worker process during an isolated Case.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Worker ownership records the crash, no orphan remains after shutdown, and replacement/retry is possible.

failure_injections.trigger: Submit an execution request with an intentionally stale Analysis Revision ID.
failure_injections.expected_signal: HTTP 409 stale-revision guard rejects the request before native execution.

failure_injections.trigger: Replay a frozen request with a stale native binding/plan hash in the isolated acceptance project.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Binding authority rejects the stale plan before the result can be trusted or promoted.

failure_injections.trigger: Create an isolated Design Revision with a geometry value outside the canonical/precheck envelope.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Design/native precheck reports the geometry issue and blocks solver submission.

failure_injections.trigger: Use an intentionally incompatible winding or unavailable material binding in the isolated acceptance design.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Validation blocks native execution with a winding/material root cause and recovery guidance.

failure_injections.trigger: Create an Analysis Revision with an operating point outside the accepted input domain.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Analysis validation/precheck blocks execution and preserves the last valid Design Revision.

failure_injections.trigger: Run a native Case with a controlled short timeout or a reproducible solver-failure condition.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Solver process is terminated/classified, Case ends fail-visible, and runtime resources are released.

failure_injections.trigger: Use an isolated analysis/output contract that produces a reproducible missing required native output.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Result extraction is incomplete and the ResultBundle/Scorecard remains unqualified rather than silently filling data.

failure_injections.trigger: Tamper a copied acceptance result/evidence artifact after its hash is frozen.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Integrity verification detects the hash mismatch and blocks formal qualification.

failure_injections.trigger: Refresh/reopen the browser while a native Case is running.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Server-side task continues under stable ownership and the refreshed UI reattaches to current status/results.

failure_injections.trigger: Gracefully stop the first Studio process after native results, start a second process, and reopen the frozen project/results.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Project, baseline and all representative ResultBundles reopen with matching identifiers/hashes.

failure_injections.trigger: Write/read acceptance evidence under a path containing Chinese characters and spaces.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Filesystem round-trip succeeds and packaged evidence remains hash-verifiable.

failure_injections.trigger: Open a representative large native field/map result through the heavy-data gateway without eager-loading the entire artifact.
failure_injections.expected_signal: Lazy/chunked read succeeds, UI remains responsive, and the artifact hash/reference remains intact.

formal_gate: 4/4 native scenarios with V0.88-A semantic authority + 17/17 observed faults + clean runtime lifecycle + complete immutable evidence package
soak_boundary: 100/500 Case soak remains V0.87-F-C and does not get inferred by this contract.
